record.original_question: If Gamma is a lattice in the isometry group of three-dimensional hyperbolic space H^3, does there exist a sequence of normal subgroups N_i normal in Gamma such that delta(N_i) / delta(Gamma) tends to 1/2?

evidence.quote: Question 4.4. If Gamma is a lattice in Isom(H^3), does there exist a sequence N_i normal in Gamma with delta(N_i) / delta(Gamma) -> 1/2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{H}^3$ denote three-dimensional hyperbolic space and let $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ be its group of isometries. For a discrete subgroup $H \leq \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$, define the critical exponent
$$\delta(H) = \inf\Big\{ s \geq 0 \;:\; \sum_{h \in H} e^{-s\, d_{\mathbb{H}^3}(o,\, h\cdot o)} < \infty \Big\},$$
where $o \in \mathbb{H}^3$ is a fixed basepoint (the value is independent of the choice of $o$). It is known that for any lattice $\Gamma \leq \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ one has $\delta(\Gamma) = 2$, and for every infinite normal subgroup $N \trianglelefteq \Gamma$ one has $\delta(N)/\delta(\Gamma) > 1/2$.

Question: Does there exist a lattice $\Gamma \leq \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ and a sequence $\{N_i\}_{i\geq 1}$ of (infinite) normal subgroups $N_i \trianglelefteq \Gamma$ such that
$$\lim_{i \to \infty} \frac{\delta(N_i)}{\delta(\Gamma)} = \frac{1}{2}\,?$$
artifact.category_tag: Critical exponents and cogrowth of Kleinian groups
artifact.status_search_result: The strict inequality $\delta(N)/\delta(\Gamma) > 1/2$ is established for normal subgroups of groups acting on hyperbolic / negatively curved spaces with strongly contracting elements (e.g., Jaerisch–Matsuzaki–Yabuki; Coulon–Dougall–Schapira–Tapie; Gekhtman–Levit; Arzhantseva–Cashen et al.). Whether the value $1/2$ is achieved as a limit for sequences of normal subgroups in a lattice of $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ does not appear to be settled in the available literature, and recent works treat $1/2$ as a sharp lower bound whose attainability (as a limit) remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Critical exponents of invariant random subgroups in negative curvature
status_evidence.snippet: For a cocompact group of isometries of a Gromov hyperbolic space, the critical exponent of any discrete IRS satisfies δ(μ) > d/2.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the 1/2 lower bound for critical exponents of IRSs/normal subgroups, but does not address attainability in the limit.

status_evidence.title: Cogrowth for group actions with strongly contracting elements
status_evidence.snippet: If N is an infinite normal subgroup of G, then δ(N)/δ(G) > 1/2.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms the strict lower bound 1/2; the question of approaching 1/2 by a sequence of normal subgroups is not resolved.
